summary.text: Shelley Tatum is the Democratic candidate for Texas House of Representatives District 9 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A retired public school teacher with 35 years in the classroom, she said in a Ballotpedia survey that she is running to increase public school funding and protect East Texas water.

paragraphs.text: Shelley Tatum earned a high school diploma from Lufkin High School and a bachelor's degree from Stephen F. Austin State University in 1987.

In a Ballotpedia survey, Tatum said she is a retired public school teacher with 35 years of classroom experience, comes from a family of teachers, and has been married 39 years with two grown daughters.
Tatum advanced from the Democratic primary on March 3, 2026.
In the survey, she said the basic per-pupil allotment should be significantly increased and that local school boards should have more decision-making authority.
She also said she would support a special aquifer district to protect the Carrizo-Wilcox aquifer and would regulate the construction and operation of AI data centers.
